description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git hash-object' command. It contains test setup, assertions, and utility functions to verify the behavior of the command under various scenarios.

methods.name: echo_without_newline
methods.description: Prints its arguments without a trailing newline.

methods.name: test_blob_does_not_exist
methods.description: Verifies that a blob object with given hash does not exist in the database.

methods.name: test_blob_exists
methods.description: Verifies that a blob object with given hash exists in the database.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository and prepares test files.

methods.name: pop_repo
methods.description: Removes the test repository and resets the environment.

methods.name: push_repo
